title: Pa11y
summary: A public automated accessibility testing runner with configurable standards, browser actions, runners, and reporters.
intended_users: Developers and accessibility practitioners checking web pages for automatable accessibility barriers.

design_decisions.problem_or_constraint: Run repeatable automated accessibility checks against dynamic web pages.
design_decisions.alternatives_considered: A fixed one-shot checker would be simpler but would not support navigation actions, standards selection, custom runners, or result filtering.
design_decisions.chosen_approach_and_rationale: Separate browser orchestration, actions, runners, configuration, and result normalization behind a programmatic API and CLI.
design_decisions.accepted_trade_off: Automated checks detect only a subset of accessibility barriers and require browser and rules-engine dependencies.
design_decisions.validation_approach: Review committed unit and integration fixtures for actions, runners, options, results, and errors without claiming execution.
design_decisions.reconsideration_conditions: Revisit runner and result contracts when accessibility engines or browser automation need incompatible lifecycle behavior.

testing_strategy: Committed tests cover options, runners, actions, errors, result filtering, and command behavior; Finch does not execute them.
security_threat: Browser navigation and arbitrary target content cross trust boundaries, but security is not the project's primary track and must not be inferred beyond visible controls.
production_limitation: Static review cannot verify browser execution, standards coverage, result accuracy, successful tests, or accessibility of any tested product.
technical_debt: Automated tooling must be combined with human accessibility evaluation and current standards guidance.
track_alignment_explanation: Finding and reporting accessibility barriers is the repository's primary purpose, directly supporting more inclusive web experiences.

ai_disclosure.purposes: No claim is made about upstream AI use; this holdout submission narrative was prepared for calibration without maintainer input.
ai_disclosure.review_validation: A human reviewer froze the reference range before model inference.
